basis: Phrases a Whisper-family recogniser is known to emit over silence, music or noise because its training subtitles carried them: subtitle-credit lines, sign-offs and sound tags. Seeded from the 2026-10-14 mini trial (Umu, Tears of Steel, Hina) and kept deliberately small and generic; nothing here is the text of one test item. A phrase list is the weaker signal: the recogniser's own no_speech_prob, avg_logprob and compression_ratio, and the segment's length against its word count, decide first (writing_coach/media_asr_filter.py). Add a line only with the case that produced it.
